desc: Parse `N`, `S`, `T`; build `target[26]`, detect any source letter mapping to multiple different targets, and record which letters appear in `S` plus `target_count` over active sources.
Compute `base` as the number of letters appearing in `S` with `target[c] != c`.
Build the non-self active-to-active functional graph and original indegrees; use Kahn pruning to identify nontrivial directed cycles.
For each detected cycle, classify it as closed iff every node in the cycle has original indegree exactly 1; count `closed_cycles`.
Apply feasibility: if `closed_cycles > 0` and all 26 letters appear in `S` and `target_count[v] <= 1` for every `v`, print `-1`; otherwise print `base + closed_cycles`.

Validate on samples and edge cases: open cycle with all letters present (should not be `-1`), closed permutation with all letters present (`-1`), closed cycle with an absent letter (`base + 1`), duplicate target creating an empty label, and self-loops ignored.
